The Sonim XP Pro sets the new standard for rugged and reliable smartphones. Its streamlined form with a large screen is built to the toughest standards including MIL-STD-810H, IP68 and IPX9K1 ratings. Connect to high bandwidth and low latency with T-Mobile’s public-safety-first T-Priority network, the nation’s first 5G slice that prioritizes first responders. Stay productive all day with a large programmable/Push-to-Talk button, 100dB+ dual loudspeakers and a 5000mAh battery. Designed to respond to every demand, the Sonim XP Pro has your back so you can have everyone else’s.

1Based on SGS lab testing & certification for MIL-STD-810H, IP68 & IPX9K ratings. These devices meet and/or exceed specification (MIL-STD-810H) testing against a subset of 9 specific environmental conditions, including temperature, humidity, dust, shock, drop, vibration, and solar radiation. Devices also tested and meet IP68 rating for dust and water (devices tested in water at a depth of 1.5 meters for 30 minutes and tested in dust chamber for 8 hours) and IPX9K rating (devices tested against 80C water jet spray). Real world usage varies from the specific environmental conditions used in MIL-STD-810H, IP68 & IPX9K testing.
